searchText: I checked the test case in question and I think it should be possible to do it in hive, I will keep posted if I find any roadblocks 👍 oh probably we're talking about different things then? we were thinking on testing several different highly forked scenarios Ah you're right, I'm talking about https://github.com/txrx-research/TestingTheMerge/pull/12/files ah yeah, that's a nice one, it should also be covered by 2965, but it's great if it can be tested live on hive Ah cool, let's wait for Mikhail then for the other one 👍 Do you have an initial set of scenarios in mind that would be nice to have before releases are out? CC'ing <@415109946682769408> as she has been looking into this recently. I have at least one. With multiple forks which eventually become invalidated except for one, CL will have to jump from one head to another to get to the right fork choice state finally. No viable head is another candidate, but if we can have it in Hive then it becomes of lower priority to be a part of consensus-tests suite
